People: Joseph Victor von Scheffel (author, Wikidata Q9082), died 1886; Sofie Delffs (translator, Wikidata Q94775028), died 1911. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Scheffel, Joseph Victor von, 1826-1886; Delffs, Sofie, 1844-1911 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Ekkehard, a tale of the tenth century, New York, Boston, T.Y. Crowell & Company, 1895, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/ekkehardatalete00dolegoog.
